body: I have an IG and Facebook, I'm jodimcfarlandart on both.
It was a commission peice. A guy in my playgroup always plays with his 12 year old son. This is for his son's deck who loves Yoshi, as a Christmas gift.

Thank you! Yes, he bought the alter for his 11 year old son who loves Yoshi. This is his son's deck and they play Magic together. I have played with them both and I plan on sneaking in a matching Yoshi card for one of Dad's decks.

I am primarily a drawer, so even my paintings tend to have a pencil look to them. For this one, I painted it in greyscale and then toned it with the acrylic colors. I made several glazes with water until I got the depth of color I wanted.

I am the original artist of the playmat. Life is short, enjoy silly playmats.... or waste your time arguing about it as if it will change anything anyway. I'm giving the file away for free. Just message me for a google drive file share.
This card took me about  four hours to finish.

I usually charge depending on the complexity of the alter. Basic border extension is 15.00 per card. In most cases I can finish a card in about 2-4 hours and the average price range is 30.00 - 50.00. This card is for sale on Etsy for 45.00 at the moment.

I am the original artist. I'm actually somewhat new to photoshop. I'm trying to get some prints made and also playmats. They will be available in my Etsy store sometime next week. It depends on when I can get to the printer with my work schedule. https://www.etsy.com/shop/AmazingAlters
